prompt: When setting up a Squid proxy, what would be a reason to limit `reply_body_max_size`?
choices: Avoid attacks on the proxy access port
Prevent the user from transmitting large video or audio files
Prevent users from downloading files of a certain size
Set a limit on the number of requests to a single site
explanation: `reply_body_max_size` caps the size of responses, preventing downloads larger than the limit.
